mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music (title, duration, audio_url, cover_url, uploader_name, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{duration}, #{audioUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{uploaderName}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE music SET title = #{title}, duration = #{duration}, audio_url = #{audioUrl}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM music ORDER BY create_time DESC
